description:
The Enhancement of Spoken English Programme was launched by the Government of India in 2018. 

This initiative aims to improve the English language skills of students across various educational institutions. 

The programme specifically targets students from economically weaker sections of society. 

It is designed to enhance their employability and communication skills in a globalized job market. 

The initiative is part of the larger Skill India Mission, which was launched in 2015. 

The Skill India Mission aims to equip the youth with skills that meet the demands of the industry. 

The Enhancement of Spoken English Programme focuses on providing quality training in spoken English. 

The objective is to make students proficient in English within a specified timeframe. 

The programme aims to train at least 1 million students by the end of 2025. 

It sets a measurable target of improving the English proficiency levels of participants by at least 30 percent. 

The training modules are designed to cover various aspects of spoken English. 

These include pronunciation, vocabulary, grammar, and conversational skills. 

The programme is implemented through a network of educational institutions. 

These institutions include government schools, colleges, and vocational training centers. 

The training is conducted by qualified trainers who are proficient in English. 

Participants receive hands-on training that includes interactive sessions and practical exercises. 

The programme also incorporates the use of digital tools and resources. 

This is to ensure that students have access to modern learning methods. 

The financial assistance provided under this programme is significant. 

Each participating institution receives a grant of up to INR 5 lakh. 

This grant is intended to cover the costs of training materials and trainer fees. 

The programme also encourages institutions to develop their own curriculum. 

This is to ensure that the training is relevant to the local context and job market. 

Eligibility for the programme is primarily based on the economic background of the students. 

Students from families with an annual income of less than INR 3 lakh are prioritized. 

There is no specific age limit for participants. 

However, the programme primarily targets students between the ages of 15 and 25. 

Educational qualifications are not a strict requirement for participation. 

The application process for institutions to join the programme is straightforward. 

Institutions must submit a proposal to the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship. 

The proposal should outline the training plan and expected outcomes. 

Required documents include the institution's registration certificate and details of the trainers. 

Once the proposal is approved, institutions can begin the training sessions. 

The programme is designed to be flexible in terms of implementation. 

Institutions can choose to conduct training sessions during regular school hours or after school. 

The training sessions typically last for three months. 

Participants are assessed at the beginning and end of the training period. 

This assessment helps to measure the improvement in their English proficiency. 

The programme also includes periodic evaluations to ensure quality training. 

Feedback from participants is collected to improve the training modules. 

The Enhancement of Spoken English Programme is monitored by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship. 

The ministry collaborates with various state governments to ensure effective implementation. 

Regular workshops and training sessions for trainers are conducted to maintain quality. 

The programme has seen participation from over 5000 institutions across India. 

As of 2023, more than 300,000 students have benefited from the programme. 

The success rate of participants achieving the targeted improvement in proficiency is approximately 70 percent. 

This indicates a positive impact on the employability of students. 

The programme also aligns with the National Education Policy 2020. 

This policy emphasizes the importance of English language proficiency in education. 

The Enhancement of Spoken English Programme is an important step towards bridging the communication gap. 

It aims to empower students from disadvantaged backgrounds. 

By improving their spoken English skills, the programme enhances their confidence. 

This, in turn, increases their chances of securing better job opportunities. 

The initiative is part of a broader effort to promote inclusivity in education. 

It recognizes the importance of language skills in today's competitive environment. 

The programme also encourages students to participate in English language competitions. 

These competitions help to further enhance their speaking skills. 

The government plans to expand the programme to include more advanced training modules. 

Future modules may focus on business communication and public speaking. 

The Enhancement of Spoken English Programme is a significant investment in the future of India's youth. 

It reflects the government's commitment to skill development and education. 

The programme aims to create a workforce that is not only skilled but also confident in their abilities. 

This initiative is crucial for India's growth in the global economy. 

The Enhancement of Spoken English Programme is a vital tool for social mobility. 

It seeks to break the cycle of poverty through education and skill development. 

The programme's long-term vision includes creating a generation of English-speaking professionals. 

This will ultimately contribute to the overall development of the nation. 

The Enhancement of Spoken English Programme is a testament to the government's efforts. 

It highlights the importance of language skills in achieving economic growth. 

The programme is expected to evolve over the coming years. 

It will adapt to the changing needs of the job market and educational landscape. 

The government remains committed to ensuring that all students have access to quality English language training. 

This initiative is a step towards a more inclusive and skilled workforce in India.
